prompt: With scanbot1, drive to aisle_2 and, if the camera sees an object there that the stock list does not know, tell channel "lead" "unknown object in aisle_2".

expect_2_3.because: 0045 C9 (detection of objects the world does not list)

why: Detection of an object the world does not list (0045 C2, C9): `objects at L` yields only what the world declares, so an unlisted object is never a candidate. G-DETECT. The attempt either reports the listed shelf as 'unknown' or reports regardless.
